title: Death's Five Pourings and the Twelve Spirits of Error
description: A cosmogony in reverse: the cosmos of darkness was built up out of Death's own poured-forth corpses in five successive emanations, producing the five worlds of the flesh and the twelve spirits of error of the zodiac, all of which arose against the First Man and were finally humbled by him. The inverted mirror of the regenerative order: outpouring → tree-of-death → bitter fruit, against the divine seed → tree → sweet fruit.
